# Children's Dental World

> A pediatric dental practice in the Chicago area specializing in comprehensive children's dental care with board-certified dentists and advanced sedation options.

Children's Dental World operates two locations in Morton Grove and Bridgeport, Chicago, Illinois, offering preventative and complex pediatric dental services. The practice is affiliated with major professional organizations including the American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD) and American Board of Pediatric Dentistry (ABPD), and actively participates in community charitable initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Board-certified dentists
- General anesthesia and IV sedation
- Chicago dental practice
- Morton Grove and Bridgeport locations
- Preventative dental care
- Dental services for children
- CareCredit financing
- AAPD and ABPD memberships
- Patient testimonials
- Insurance accepted (Aetna, Aflac)
- Dental technology and imaging
- Community involvement
- New patient forms
- Appointment scheduling
